name: 21619 · Chester, MD
findings: ZIP 21619 (Chester) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21619 (Chester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21619 (Chester) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
